comment.text: Nice! What happens when two sessions edit the same file at once? Does claudio detect the conflict or does the last write win?

cases.note: Improve on a Bluesky post: the answer must be plain text, since Bluesky shows every * and # as typed. A problem in the record is Markdown the page would have had to clean.
cases.text: claudio v0.9.0 is out. It runs Claude Code as a service: a REST API, sessions you can resume, and a web UI to follow them. The most important change is that it now detects when two sessions edit the same file. https://josegarrido.dev/en/claudio/?ref=bluesky

analysis.summary: claudio runs Claude Code as a service behind a REST API, with resumable sessions and a web UI.
implemented: REST API to start and follow Claude Code sessions
